content.value_statement: Value investors need consistent Graham and Buffett analysis across markets. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Longbridge-based research workflows.
actual_capabilities: Routes Graham and Buffett requests to the correct single-stock or screening workflow.
Defines Longbridge CLI and MCP fallback steps for fundamentals, quotes, ownership, and dividends.
Applies Graham NCAV, defensive investor, and value-trap checks before score output.
Applies Buffett moat, financial health, management, valuation, and long-term visibility dimensions.
Requires reconciliation checks, data source appendices, and investment disclaimers in reports.
limitations: Requires Longbridge CLI, MCP, or approved web sources for current market data.
Does not provide investment advice or personalized trading recommendations.
Accuracy depends on available filings, Longbridge coverage, and reconciled financial statements.
Some sectors are excluded when Graham or Buffett methods are unsuitable.

use_cases.title: Deep-value stock diagnostic
use_cases.description: Analyze one ticker against Graham NCAV, liquidation value, dividend support, debt safety, and value-trap rules.

use_cases.title: Quality compounder shortlist
use_cases.description: Screen a market or sector for Buffett-style companies with durable moats, clean financials, and reasonable valuation.

use_cases.title: Standardized research reports
use_cases.description: Produce consistent bilingual research outputs with source appendices, reconciliation gates, and clear framework boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze one stock
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner single-stock Graham or Buffett review
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze AAPL.US with the Buffett moat framework. Include moat strength, financial health, valuation, holding-period view, and data sources.

prompt_templates.title: Find Graham candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Screen Hong Kong stocks for Graham NCAV candidates. Rank the top candidates and show value-trap warnings and source notes.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Buffett shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Buffett-style consumer stocks in the US market. Use quality filters first, then discuss valuation and minimum holding period.

prompt_templates.title: Compare both lenses
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare 00700.HK with Graham and Buffett methods. Explain where the frameworks agree, where they conflict, and which lens fits better.

output_examples.output: A report with five moat dimensions, a holding-period estimate, valuation context, source appendix, and an investment-risk disclaimer.

output_examples.input: Find net-net stocks in the Hong Kong market.
output_examples.output: A ranked Graham-style candidate list with NCAV ratios, defensive filters, exclusions, data limitations, and value-trap warnings.

output_examples.input: Compare Graham and Buffett views on a technology stock.
output_examples.output: A side-by-side explanation of cheapness, moat quality, financial durability, margin of safety, and framework fit.

best_practices: Provide a clear ticker, market, sector, or screening universe before requesting analysis.
Use Graham prompts for asset-backed deep value and Buffett prompts for durable quality businesses.
Review the data source appendix before relying on any score or ranking.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a framework score as a buy or sell recommendation.
Do not use Graham NCAV logic for banks, insurers, REITs, or other excluded financial structures.
Do not mix Longbridge data and web-sourced figures without source labels.

faq.question: Does this skill give investment advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides research structure and factual analysis for reference only.

faq.question: Which markets can it analyze?
faq.answer: It can work with markets covered by Longbridge data and supported symbol formats.

faq.question: When should I use the Graham workflow?
faq.answer: Use it for deep-value, NCAV, net-net, liquidation-value, and defensive-investor questions.

faq.question: When should I use the Buffett workflow?
faq.answer: Use it for moat quality, long-term compounders, durable earnings, and valuation discipline.

faq.question: Can it screen many stocks?
faq.answer: Yes. It defines batch workflows for Graham candidates and Buffett-style quality shortlists.

faq.question: What data checks are included?
faq.answer: The workflows require cross-statement reconciliation before scoring and source appendices for reported figures.
